notes.title: Big News: Permanent Price Down!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’ve got exciting news — the price of [b]The Last Earth Fighter[/b] has been permanently reduced to [b]6.99 USD[/b]! 🎉[/p][p]If you've been waiting for the right moment to try it, now's the time![/p][p]Thank you for your support and enjoy the game![/p][p]– [b]The Last Earth Fighter [/b]Team 🚀[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613170/096bdd7b7202897d284218ba8b6abed8398a5dde.png"][/img][/p]
